title: unify sdks: auth/retries + streaming ergonomics + parity fixes (v1.138.0)
author: Maya Gupta
description: Summary: This PR consolidates auth/retries behavior, improves streaming ergonomics, and applies parity fixes compared to the Python and Go SDKs. It also bumps the TypeScript SDK to v1.138.0 and updates changelogs. Motivation: several downstream services observed inconsistent retry semantics and subtle streaming resume bugs across languages. To reduce developer friction we aligned defaults and surface area across SDKs so customers get consistent behavior regardless of language. Changes include: 1) Auth: unified token refresh strategy with a shared backoff and single refresh inflight deduping. This replaces per-client timers with a centralized token manager. 2) Retries: standardize transient error classification and retry jitter parameters; expose RetryPolicyOptions for advanced users. 3) Streaming APIs: ergonomic improvements to the streaming client: optional async iterator + callback compatibility, clearer close/error semantics, and graceful resume on reconnect for partial payloads. 4) Parity fixes: small API surface mismatches fixed (naming, optional params) to match Python/Go SDKs. 5) Version bump: package.json, changelog, and release metadata updated to v1.138.0. Checklist: - [x] Implementation (TS) - [x] Unit tests for token manager and retry logic - [x] Integration test against mock streaming server - [x] Cross-SDK compatibility verification with Python/Go reference branches - [x] CHANGELOG and release notes updated - [x] Docs snippet for streaming ergonomics Migration notes: Consumers with custom retry/token logic should consult the new RetryPolicyOptions and the TokenManager migration section in docs; default behavior is backwards-compatible for 99% of users but edge cases where callers relied on multiple concurrent token refreshes could see different timing (improvement). Rollback plan: revert the feature branch; a minor point-release (v1.138.1) is prepared in case we need a targeted fix. Related work: ENG-1234 (auth unification), ENG-1256 (streaming ergonomics), SUP-987 (customer-reported resume bug). Links: internal design doc https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-1234/unify-sdk-auth-refresh and test matrix https://ci.internal/redwood/sdk-e2e. Testing: all unit and integration suites passed locally and in CI; E2E matrix ran against Python/Go branches and validated parity for the common surface. Merge notes: Squash+merge after final approval; changelog entry consolidated. Future: follow-up PR will expose enhanced metrics for token refresh latency and retry counts (no user-visible behavior change).

release_notes: v1.138.0 — Unify auth token refresh and retry semantics, streaming ergonomics improvements (async iterator + graceful resume), parity fixes with Python/Go SDKs, minor API aliasing for backwards compatibility.
notes_for_release_manager: No config changes required for customers using default clients. Watch metrics: token_refresh_latency, retry_attempts. Rollout strategy: release to npm, monitor error rates for 48h. If an issue, publish v1.138.1 with targeted rollback of TokenManager behavior.
